Grandma Ruth's Icebox Rolls

Soft dinner rolls that rise overnight in the refrigerator.

Prep: 25 min Bake: 18 min Makes 24 rolls

  • 1 package active dry yeast
  • 2 cups warm milk
  • 1/2 cup margarine, melted
  • 6 cups all-purpose flour
  1. Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk.
  2. Stir in the flour and knead until smooth.
  3. Chill overnight, shape into rolls, and bake at 375F for 18 minutes.
